name: doverde (Delaware Open Vendor Expense & Revenue Data Engine)
what_it_holds: Automated ETL using Polars + the Socrata Open Data API against Delaware's state checkbook/revenue open-data portal (1 star, MIT, updated Mar 2026, designed to run in Colab).
why_useful: Not STR-specific, but a recent, actively-maintained example of a full Socrata ETL pipeline (auth, pagination, incremental pulls) that could be repurposed against any state Socrata portal carrying lodging-tax or transient-occupancy-tax collections (gap 8).

name: PortalJS
what_it_holds: 2.4k-star, actively developed (Sep 2026) TypeScript/Next.js framework for scaffolding data portals with a unified DataProvider interface across CKAN, Socrata, OpenDataSoft, ArcGIS, GitHub, Frictionless Data, DKAN, and OpenMetadata backends; MIT license.
why_useful: A single abstraction layer that could pull from multiple portal families (Socrata + CKAN + OpenDataSoft + ArcGIS) with one interface, useful as connective tooling if the team wants to build a repeatable STR/tourism-dataset harvester across the many named city/country sources in gaps 7-13.

name: apd-core
what_it_holds: Machine-readable CSV backing store for awesome-public-datasets, organized as one CSV per category (e.g. core/Transportation.csv) with dataset name/url/description columns; source-of-truth for new dataset PRs to the main list.
why_useful: Lets a future pass query the whole awesome-public-datasets index programmatically (e.g. filter Transportation.csv, Economics.csv) instead of scraping the rendered README; the Transportation.csv category file was confirmed present via GitHub contents API on 14 Sep 2026 (fetch of raw file 404'd, likely a path/branch mismatch worth revisiting).
